command:
set -u
printf 'BEFORE active=%s mainpid=%s active_enter=%s\n' "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)" "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)" "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)"
printf '%s\n' '--- INSPECT ---'
sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py --config /etc/entityos/entityos.conf --service entityos-vm.service inspect
inspect_rc=$?
printf 'INSPECT_RC=%s\n' "$inspect_rc"
printf '%s\n' '--- CONDITION ---'
sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py --config /etc/entityos/entityos.conf --service entityos-vm.service condition
condition_rc=$?
printf 'CONDITION_RC=%s\n' "$condition_rc"
printf 'AFTER active=%s mainpid=%s active_enter=%s\n' "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)" "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)" "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)"
exit 0
